summary: Iteration 10 — Frontend-only regression for the 7 user-requested changes on the preview URL. Tested via Playwright with real demo (admin) login (demo@emergent.sh/demo12345) and verified diyea login with new password. ALL 7 features PASS end-to-end. No console errors beyond expected /api/auth/me 401 pre-auth and two /api/leads/notes/recent 400s (carry-over from iter_8/9 — silently handled).

integration_issues.issue: /api/leads/notes/recent returns 400 (was 404 in iter_9). Silently handled, no UI crash, carry-over low-priority.

action_items: (Low / carry-over) /api/leads/notes/recent now returns 400 instead of 404 — either implement endpoint properly or stop calling it from Leads.js.
critical_code_review_comments: All 7 requested changes implemented correctly and verified end-to-end. Tour overlay correctly persists localStorage flag crm_tour_v1_done='1' on finish/skip and skips auto-start on reload while still being replay-able via take-tour-btn.

Change-password modal correctly REJECTS wrong current password with toast/error message and ACCEPTS correct current+new (>=8 chars) — confirmed by changing demo12345→tempnewpw12345 and back successfully.

Meetings page title 'Meetings' fully visible at BOTH 1920x800 (y=32) and 1440x768 (y=32). Calendar day headers (SUN 14, MON 15…SAT 20) and time gutter (12pm-5pm) all fully visible — chopped-top fix confirmed.

Meeting drawer (Owen Carter, 02:00 PM · Dipan) opens with title fully visible (y=16) and EXPOSES full action UI: mark-show-btn, mark-noshow-btn, meeting-notes-input, reschedule-input, reschedule-btn, meeting-view-lead-btn — all present. Reschedule to 2026-12-15T14:30 produced 'Meeting rescheduled' toast. View-lead navigated correctly to /leads/552474b7-5d3d-4cd1-ae82-edcb92d0cb87.

Payments → new-payment-link-btn → lead-picker-modal with lead-picker-search returned 25 lead-picker-option-* matches; selecting one opened payment-modal with generate-payment-btn; clicking it produced a success toast (Stripe test-mode link generated). Full custom-link flow verified.
Demo login page shows ONLY demo@emergent.sh (no diyea/aryan quick-login). Old leader123 password correctly REJECTED for diyea; new emergent@12345 password correctly ACCEPTED.
Admin nav visibility verified (nav-campaigns, nav-team, nav-audit all present for demo account).
No JS errors, no missing-export crashes after the latest refactor. Dark theme intact across all touched pages (Login, Dashboard, Meetings, Payments, Lead Detail).
